documents.title: Center for Environmental Science & Engineering Research
documents.text:
## About

The Center for Environmental Science & Engineering Research (CESER) is the oldest center of CUET focuses the research on all aspect of Environmental Science and Engineering topics in the context to Global Environmental Challenges and Sustainable Development. In this regard, the center is working for developing local environmental manpower and expertise in order to enhance the economic growth of the country without damaging the quality of the environment, to promote and provide facilities for offering consultation services to development agencies and partners in matters of environmental relevance. The center is committed to develop an environmental management information system (EMIS) within the center to facilitate collection and dissemination of information and training materials to institutions that train environmental professionals. The center is also working to help in formulating the codes of practices for a cleaner and greener environment.

## Vision

**Aims & Objectives of the Center **

The overall aim of the Center is to create a Center of Excellence with state of art research facilities and study in the area of Environmental Science and Engineering. In this regard the followings shall be the objectives of the Center:

a) To promote and provide facilities for
i. Post graduate diploma and certificate programs for the professionals
ii. Advanced studies and research facilities for students, teachers and professionals
iii. Developing local environmental manpower and expertise in order to enhance the economic growth of the country without damaging the quality of the environment
iv. Mainstreaming environmental dimension within the processes of planning, design, implementation, operation and maintenance of development projects
v. Developing capacity for environmental research in order to support environmentally sound development programs in the country
vi. Training and education to technologist, managers, decision makers, academician and other concerned officials in sound management approaches, parallel to technological and least cost solutions to the environmental problems
vii. Providing specific project oriented training to professionals of industries and other development agencies within the energy sector
viii. Offering consultation services to development agencies and partners in matters of environmental relevance
ix. Conducting research in areas of global and national environmental problems, and
x. Developing an environmental management information system (EMIS) within the center to facilitate collection and dissemination of information and training materials to institutions that train environmental professionals.

b) To provide necessary forum for professional engineers and policy & decision makers to exchange ideas in the field of environmental science and engineering both at home and abroad

c) To help in formulating the codes of practices for cleaner and greener environment:
i. Bangladesh Standards for environmental quality (e.g. air quality, water quality, wastewater quality, noise quality, sediment quality and etc.)
ii. Bangladesh Standard Code of Practice for plumbing system for residential commercial and industrial building
iii. Bangladesh Standard Code of Practice for water and wastewater treatment plant design, and
iv. Bangladesh Standard Code of Practice for Environmental Impact assessment

## Mission

**Mission**
The Center for Environmental Science and Engineering Research (CESER) will be established to provide world class research facilities to achieve “Center of Excellence”. It would be guided by an Advisory Committee of leading environmental practitioners and is committed to conduct research at advanced level. The Center is expected to create state-of-the-art research facilities covering all aspect of Environmental Science and Engineering topics in the context to Global Environmental Challenges.
The Center is also committed to develop curriculum, code, standard, guideline and regulation for a safer and cleaner environment. The center will also be involved in the public awareness building program in relation to Environmental issues subjected to national and international interest.

## Message from the Head

Environmental science is an interdisciplinary academic field that integrates physical, chemical, biological and information sciences to the study of the environment and the solution of environmental problems. Environmental engineering focuses on design and technology to improve environmental quality in everyday life. Now-a –days global warming is a buzz issue that is caused due to anthropogenic environmental pollution. With the rapid changes, there is a need to study each step that may alter the environment so that the natural ecosystem may still be protected or replaced by a better one. The purpose of this center is to strengthen environmental governance that will lead to the adoption of improved environmental practices, technologies, and services, particularly in addressing air pollution, water and waste management challenges.

## Laboratories

Center for Environmental Science & Engineering Research (CESER)’s laboratory has the following equipments:

i. Atomic Absorption Spectrophotometer-200

ii. Portable Spectrophotometer

iii. Portable Bacteriological kit

iv. Portable/Bench top Digital Multipara Meter.

v. Magnetic Stirrer

vi. Distilled Water Unit

vii. Filtration System

viii. Group Heater

 ix. Digital Arsenometer

x.  Water Quality Meter

## About

The Institute of Information and Communication Technology (IICT) is dedicated to advancing postgraduate education, research, and professional training in ICT to develop skilled manpower and knowledge-based solutions for national growth. Through its Academic and System & Support wings, IICT provides modern ICT infrastructure, develops university software systems, and offers industry-relevant training programs to meet evolving technological demands.

Below, the works and responsibilities of IICT are presented in detail.

### **1. Academic Activities**

IICT offers Post-graduate Degree and Diplomas in different subjects of ICT.

### **1.1 Degree Programs**

- Offer **Postgraduate Diploma programs in ICT**.
- Offer (proposed) **M.Sc. Engg. / M. Engg. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Engineering**.
- Offer (proposed) **M.Sc. Engg. / M. Engg. in Cybersecurity and Digital Forensics**.

### **1.2 Training Programs**

- Conduct training under **Enhancing Digital Government and Economy (EDGE)** initiative.
- Provide training in **Basic Networking**.
- Provide training in **Full Stack Software Development**.

## **2. IT Infrastructure Management**

The CUET campus network has an upward of 6,000 active users. This sheer number of users in one network is much higher than any commercial ISP supports in Bangladesh.

### **2.1 Wi-Fi Network Management**

- Setup, maintain, and provide support for Wi-Fi in:

  - Academic buildings
  - Administrative buildings
  - Student residential halls
  - Library
  - Auditorium, cafeteria, TSC, and medical center
  - Teacher & Officer residential areas (single and family units)
  - Staff residential areas (single and family units)

  - Academic buildings
  - Administrative buildings
  - Student residential halls
  - Library
  - Teacher & Officer residential areas (single and family units)
  - Staff residential areas (single and family units)
  - additional internet connectivity across the campus where needed.

### **2.3 Internet and Backbone Infrastructure**

- Maintain **campus backbone network using optical fiber**.
- Manage **data servers**

  - **On-Premises **
  - **Cloud based**

- Configure and maintain **firewalls and security systems**.

### **3.2 Website Services**

### **3.4 Custom Software Development**

  - Custom applications for academic and administrative operations
  - Automation tools for university administrative workflows.
  - Custom software development services for external organizations.
  - Software Quality Assurance (SQA) services for software systems developed within the university as well as for external software projects.

### **3.5 Office Applications**

## **4. Security Infrastructure**

- Perform:

  - Camera setup and maintenance

  - NVR and DVR system maintenance
  - Backup and on-demand video export
  - Ensure continuous power supply for remote camera locations

## **5. ID Card Services**

  - Students

## **7. Procurement Services**

## About

Welcome to the Department of Nuclear Engineering at Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET), a pioneering institution dedicated to advancing knowledge and expertise in nuclear engineering and technology within the context of Bangladesh. Our department assumes a pivotal role in shaping future leaders in the field, offering comprehensive academic programs spanning from undergraduate to doctoral levels. With an unwavering commitment to academic excellence, research, and societal service, we aspire to make significant contributions to the development of Bangladesh's nuclear infrastructure. Explore our website to gain insights into our educational offerings, research endeavors, and the accomplished faculty and students who constitute our vibrant academic community. Join us in the collective pursuit of excellence in nuclear engineering at CUET. In addressing the challenges of the 21st century and aligning with the government's vision to advance Bangladesh, Nuclear Engineering assumes a pivotal role. Professionals in this domain focus on harnessing energy from nuclear reactions. Bangladesh is progressively incorporating nuclear engineering for diverse applications, spanning power generation, medicine, and industrial and agricultural processes. The effective management of nuclear infrastructure and materials necessitates the presence of skilled professionals. The initiation of nuclear engineering and technology education at CUET fulfils this imperative, aligning with CUET's distinguished role in higher education, research, and development in engineering and applied sciences in Bangladesh. The Department of Nuclear Engineering (NE) at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET) was established in February 2019 under the esteemed faculty of Engineering and Technology.

## Vision

The Nuclear Engineering Department at Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology aims to excel globally in higher education for the peaceful applications of nuclear energy while serving as a centre of excellence in education, research, and technical support and creating man power for the country's nuclear power program.

## Mission

- **Academic Excellence: **Cultivate highly proficient nuclear engineers across educational levels, from undergraduate to postgraduate, empowering them to contribute substantive engineering acumen to the design, construction, and operation of Bangladesh's nuclear power plants. Fostering a diverse and inclusive community of scholars, professionals and students dedicated to advancing the peaceful and beneficial uses of nuclear technology for the betterment of society.
- **Centre of Academic Distinction:** Strive to achieve recognition as a distinguished academic centre for nuclear engineering and technology, encompassing nuclear power, nuclear medicine, and nuclear applications in agriculture. Dedicate efforts to provide exceptional education, conduct impactful research, and extend meaningful outreach initiatives. The centre also offers technical expertise and professional support to advance Bangladesh’s nuclear infrastructure, promote the safe and effective use of nuclear power in the national energy landscape, enhance healthcare through nuclear medicine, and support sustainable agricultural development through peaceful nuclear technologies.
- **Nuclear Research Facility Development: **Committed to the development of a modern Nuclear Research Facility to support advanced education, cutting-edge research, and innovation in nuclear science and technology. The facility will enhance capabilities in nuclear power, radiation applications, nuclear medicine, and agricultural technologies while ensuring the highest standards of safety and regulatory compliance.
- **Public and Professional Engagement:** Undertake service initiatives for industry, government, professional bodies, and the wider public, focusing on areas pertinent to nuclear and radiological engineering. Promoting nuclear safety, security, and non-proliferation through rigorous research, education, and outreach efforts.

## Message from the Head

As the Head of the Department of Nuclear Engineering at the Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET), I have the honour of overseeing a distinguished assembly of educators and scholars. ## About

The **Department of Chemistry at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET)** is a vibrant academic and research community dedicated to excellence in chemistry education, fundamental and applied research, innovation, and technological development. We strive to create an inspiring and inclusive environment where students, faculty, researchers, and staff can explore new ideas, develop their potential, and contribute meaningfully to academia, industry, and society.

With a **history spanning more than five decades**, the Department has played an important role in providing students from various engineering disciplines with a strong foundation in chemistry—the **central science that connects engineering, technology, medicine, agriculture, environmental science, materials science, and many other fields**. Our undergraduate chemistry education emphasizes both fundamental concepts and practical laboratory skills, enabling students to understand the principles of chemistry and apply them to real-world technological and engineering challenges.

The Department is committed not only to teaching but also to **advancing knowledge through high-quality research and innovation**. Our research activities cover a broad spectrum of contemporary areas, including **environmental chemistry, natural product chemistry, nanochemistry, materials science, computational chemistry, biological chemistry, surface science, polymer science, electrochemistry, theoretical chemistry**, and other emerging interdisciplinary fields. Through these activities, we seek to address important scientific, environmental, technological, and societal challenges at both national and global levels.

### Graduate and Postgraduate Education

The Department expanded its academic portfolio by introducing **M.Phil. and Ph.D. programs in Chemistry in 2009**, providing opportunities for advanced research and the development of future leaders in chemical sciences. Subsequently, the **M.Sc. program was introduced in 2017**, further strengthening the Department's graduate education and research capacity.

Our graduate and postgraduate programs are designed for students who are passionate about chemistry and motivated to pursue advanced scientific research. Students have opportunities to work closely with experienced faculty members in interdisciplinary research environments, develop advanced experimental and analytical skills, publish scientific research, and contribute to the development of innovative solutions to contemporary challenges.

### Research, Innovation, and Collaboration

We believe that the future of chemistry lies at the intersection of **fundamental science, engineering, technology, and innovation**. Therefore, the Department encourages interdisciplinary research and collaboration with academic institutions, industries, government organizations, and national and international research communities.

Our goal is to transform scientific knowledge into practical solutions in areas such as **sustainable materials, environmental protection, clean water, emerging contaminants, advanced oxidation processes, energy, nanotechnology, and other areas of strategic importance**.

### Commitment to Industry and Society

In addition to our academic and research activities, the Department contributes to industry and society through **professional testing, analytical, and consultancy services**. These activities provide technical support to industries, organizations, researchers, and other stakeholders while creating opportunities for our faculty and researchers to engage with real-world scientific and technological challenges.

We consider our engagement with industry and society an integral part of our mission. It enables us to translate academic expertise into practical solutions while continuously strengthening our capacity to address the evolving technological challenges of the twenty-first century.

### Looking Ahead

As we move forward, the Department of Chemistry remains committed to building a **center of excellence in chemistry education, research, and innovation**. We aim to nurture scientifically competent, creative, ethical, and globally competitive graduates and researchers who can contribute to sustainable technological development and address the challenges facing Bangladesh and the world.

**We warmly welcome students, researchers, academics, industry partners, and collaborators to join our journey of learning, discovery, innovation, and service.**

**Welcome to the Department of Chemistry at CUET—where chemistry meets engineering, innovation, and the future.**

## Vision

To be a **nationally and internationally recognized center of excellence in chemistry education, research, and innovation**, producing highly skilled, ethical, and creative graduates and researchers who contribute to scientific advancement, technological innovation, environmental sustainability, and the socio-economic development of Bangladesh and the global community.

## Mission

The Department of Chemistry, CUET is committed to:

**Providing high-quality, innovative, and student-centered education** in chemistry that develops strong theoretical knowledge, practical skills, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.

**Promoting cutting-edge research and innovation** in fundamental and applied chemistry to address emerging scientific, technological, environmental, and societal challenges.

**Developing competent and ethical professionals, researchers, and future leaders** equipped with the knowledge, skills, creativity, and integrity required to contribute effectively to academia, industry, research organizations, and society.

**Advancing interdisciplinary and collaborative research** by fostering national and international partnerships with academic institutions, industries, government organizations, and research communities.

**Promoting sustainable chemistry and environmentally responsible technologies** to address challenges related to clean water, environmental pollution, energy, climate change, health, and sustainable development.

**Encouraging innovation, entrepreneurship, and technology transfer** to transform scientific knowledge and research outcomes into practical solutions for national and global needs.

**Creating an inclusive, safe, and intellectually stimulating academic environment** that encourages lifelong learning, scientific curiosity, creativity, collaboration, and professional development.

**Contributing to national development and the advancement of society** through excellence in education, research, innovation, knowledge dissemination, and community engagement.

## Message from the Head

**Welcome to the Department of Chemistry at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET).**

Chemistry is often described as the central science because it connects and contributes to almost every aspect of our lives. From the materials we use and the medicines we depend on to clean water, energy, agriculture, environmental protection, and advanced technologies, **chemistry is fundamental to understanding and shaping the world around us**. In an era of rapid scientific and technological transformation, chemistry continues to serve as a powerful driving force behind innovations in engineering, medicine, agriculture, environmental science, energy, and materials technology.

The **Department of Chemistry at CUET** is committed to excellence in education, research, innovation, and the development of skilled human resources. The Department provides a stimulating academic and research environment for undergraduate students from different engineering disciplines, as well as graduate and postgraduate students. We strive to develop a strong foundation in chemical sciences while encouraging students to think critically, explore creatively, and apply their knowledge to real-world challenges.

The Department offers **M.Sc., M.Phil., and Ph.D. programs in Chemistry**, providing opportunities for advanced study and research across a broad range of contemporary and interdisciplinary areas. Our research encompasses **environmental chemistry, natural product chemistry, nanochemistry, materials science, computational chemistry, biological chemistry, surface science, polymer science, electrochemistry, theoretical chemistry**, and other emerging fields. Through these research activities, we aim to generate new knowledge and develop innovative solutions to pressing national and global challenges.

Our greatest strength is our **dedicated faculty members, researchers, and staff**, who are highly qualified, enthusiastic, cooperative, and committed to academic and research excellence. We believe that a supportive and inclusive academic environment is essential for nurturing curiosity, creativity, integrity, and scientific excellence. Accordingly, we encourage close interaction among students, faculty, and researchers and promote interdisciplinary collaboration both within CUET and with national and international institutions.

As a department within an engineering-focused university, we particularly value the integration of **chemistry with engineering and technology**. Our goal is not only to teach chemistry but also to empower our students and researchers to translate chemical knowledge into practical technologies and sustainable solutions. We are committed to addressing contemporary challenges such as **environmental pollution, emerging contaminants, clean water, sustainable materials, energy, public health, and climate change** through innovative research and collaboration.

We warmly welcome students, researchers, academics, industries, and collaborators to engage with our Department. Whether you are seeking a strong academic foundation, an opportunity for advanced research, interdisciplinary collaboration, or a platform for innovation, we hope you will find the Department of Chemistry at CUET an inspiring place to learn, discover, and contribute.

**Together, we aspire to nurture a generation of scientifically skilled engineers, chemists, researchers, and innovators who will create meaningful discoveries, develop sustainable technologies, and contribute to a better future for Bangladesh and the world.**

Once again, **welcome to the Department of Chemistry at CUET**. We look forward to learning, discovering, and innovating together.

## About

As the geographical location of the institution is in a hilly region, the scope of planning and its application has been widened to new dimension that distinguishes unique identity from other institutions. Tourism and Recreational Planning in hilly region like Chittagong, the commercial capital of Bangladesh will contribute a lot to national economy.

The Department of Urban and Regional Planning (DURP) has been established in 2009 under the faculty of Architecture and Planning, offering Bachelor degree in Urban and Regional Planning. In view of meeting the growing demand of planners in government and nongovernment organizations, universities and research institutes, DURP has introduced this bachelor program. Under this program 30 students are enrolled each year. At least 159 credit hours must be completed within 4 academic years to fulfill the entire requirement of this degree.

DURP at Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET) is primarily concerned with the development planning at the urban, rural, regional and local levels. Besides this program encourages its students to develop specializations within the field of urban planning, rural planning, transportation planning, housing and real estate development, disaster management and environmental planning, tourism and recreation planning and to expand their intellectual horizons through training in the related fields of architecture, landscape planning, civil engineering, social science, public policy and political science. In Project/Thesis work, provision of analyzing any urban, rural or regional problems with major findings and recommendation concerning sustainable planning perspective is exposed for all the fellows.
At present the academic program is successfully running with 15 (Fifteen) teachers and 4 (Four) adjunct faculty who provide their best expertise level for the fellow student. Besides, department hire specialized and experienced personnel from professional field to teach the fellow students as guest teacher. The Department is persistent in its efforts to improve its research facilities to meet the growing technological challenges confronting the country.

## Vision

Vision of the department is to become a leading urban and regional planning department in worldwide with teaching and research facilities to contribute in sustainable urban and rural development.

**Aim of this program**

Urban and regional planning is a dynamic field that requires innovative solutions from committed and thoughtful individuals. Historically, it emerged out of the convergence of two concerns:
• The provision of urban infrastructure.
• The initiation of social reform.
Today, the underlying focus on community well-being continues, urban and regional planning has broadened to include the development, implementation, and evaluation of a wide range of policies. Specifically urban and regional planners, in both developing and developed countries, are concerned with:

• The use of land in the city, in the suburbs, and in rural areas, and particularly with the transition from one use to another.
• Potential adverse impacts of human activities on a limited physical environment and the possible mitigation of those impacts.
• The design of the city and the surrounding region so as to facilitate the activities in which people need and desire to engage.
• Settlement systems and the location of human activities in urban and regional space.
• Identification of social needs and the design and provision of services and facilities to meet those needs.
• The distribution of resources, benefits and costs among people.
• The anticipation of change and its impact on how people do and can live.
• Participation of citizens in planning processes which affect their future.
• The way that choices are made, decisions implemented and actions evaluated, and the means by which those processes can be improved in urban and regional areas.

**Our Identity**
We view planning as a professional and intellectual endeavor. We are strongly committed not only to the education of the next generation of planning professionals and leaders, but also to augmenting the profession through significant research accomplishments that are disseminated widely to academic and professional audiences. The Department’s faculty, students, and staff therefore engage in activities that simultaneously serve education, research, and public and professional engagement functions.

We emphasize the ecological, economic, social, and institutional aspects of urban and regional development and the theory and practice of planning processes. We teach and conduct research to improve understanding of human settlements and of planning situations and we focus on planning as the achievement of outcomes based on interrelated actions over time and space, not merely on individual policies or administrative decisions. Collaboration and close communication with a wide range of disciplines and professions is thus inherent in our approach. This collaboration is enhanced through faculty appointed in the department whose degrees are in architecture, economics, geography, history, law, political science, regional science, and zoology. We encourage faculty to pursue interdisciplinary research and to make scholarly contributions to both planning and fields closely allied with planning and we encourage and facilitate dual degree programs for students who wish professional qualifications in related fields.

We recognize planning for cities and regions as a process with a design component, in addition to ecological and human behavioral components. As a result, we seek to leverage our location in the College of Fine and Applied Arts to exploit innovative collaborative education, teaching and engagement opportunities with design-oriented disciplines, especially with the Department of Architecture.

We seek to understand human settlement and propose planning solutions at multiple spatial scales and locations—site, neighborhood, city, region, nation, and world. We therefore conduct research all over the world, and we seek a student body that is not just diverse in terms of gender, race and ethnicity, but also in terms of regional and national origin.

**Aspirations**
Our vision of our identity is based on a set of aspirations that guide our programs and influence the general direction of the Department.
• We are an intellectually exciting, creative, and productive community of students, scholars, and professionals. We engage in close interaction with related units, including not only Architecture, but also Agriculture and Consumer Economics, Civil Engineering, Economics, Education, Natural Resources and Environmental Sciences, Finance, Geography, Government and Public Affairs, Human and Community Development, Law, Psychology, Social Work, and Sociology.
• We maintain an active program in neighborhood and community empowerment through community engagement and other professional activities that integrate teaching, research, and service.
• We have a diverse, representative, student body, faculty, and staff interacting with and enhancing each other as individuals.
• We involve the frequent participation of practicing professionals in activities on campus.
• We offer active continuing education opportunities for professional and citizen planners.
• We foster the international exchange of planning ideas and experience through teaching, research, public service, and active roles in international organizations.
• Our programs and research have a strong environmental component, bringing environmental science results to bear on specific planning situations.

Bangladeshi graduated planners to make scope in the field of operations other than BIP, planning professionals are always encouraged to be affiliated by the societies in Earthquake Research, Disaster Management and Mitigation, Environment, Conservation, Rehabilitation, national and international professional bodies very closely related to Urban and Regional Planning.

**Migration to other profession**
Very frequently, planners with their bachelor degree are undertaking Masters’ Program in different field of Engineering and Development Planning. As the Bachelor of Urban and Regional Planning Degree program is designed with interdisciplinary attitude of acquiring knowledge in diverse field of learning and practicing, it is now planners’ choice to migrate, or to be in the same field of operation according to the market demand of working professionals.
Doors are always open to make Masters’ and Doctoral studies in Disaster and Environmental Engineering (CUET, BRAC), Disaster Management (Denmark, Norway, UK), Photogrammetry and Geoinformatics (Germany, USA), Geographical Information System (Sweden, the Netherlands, Portugal, Spain), Physical Geography (Canada, USA, Australia), Human Settlements (Belgium, China, UK, Chili), Urban Design (UK), Regional Planning (Germany), Business Administration (USA, Canada, Australia), etc.

**Job hunting and Scholarships for higher studies**

## About

Population growth and economic development continue to place increasing stress on global water resources, stresses that stem primarily from rising consumptive demands for limited supplies and increasing contaminant loads to natural waters. This growing population and need for clean water at everywhere demands specific professional on Water Resources Engineers to develop solutions that are environmentally sustainable, economically viable and socially acceptable. In view of that, the Department of Water Resources Engineering (WRE) has been established in CUET with the vision of producing the knowledgebase to tackle the challenges in a scientific and engineering way. Despite considerable advances in technology and engineering, managing and protecting water is still a challenge in particular to Bangladesh context. River erosion, deterioration of waterways are major concern for the development of river system in the country. In addition managing floods, droughts and climate change related disasters are becoming more challenging issues for water resources management and development. Proper utilization of water resources has become the fundamental element of the strategy to improve the quality of life in Bangladesh, contributing to sustainable development of the community and thereby reducing poverty and sufferings. Mainstreaming Water Resources Engineering knowledge in the core of Civil Engineering field is a time worthy demand for the society now-a-days. To satisfy this basic demand, the WRE Department of CUET offers Undergraduate Degree Programme to impart education towards an understanding of the complexity of water use and water resources engineering problems by offering a balanced curriculum, covering both engineering and management aspects of water resource development. Our aim is to teach students to acquire knowledge and hand on practice tool and techniques to come up with viable and sustainable solutions. Graduates from this department will be able to face the current challenges of securing water and effectively deal with spatial and temporal variability and uncertainty of water.

Civil engineering plays a vital role in improving public health, safety, and quality of life. Civil engineering is inherently multidisciplinary, combining technical expertise with a broader understanding of societal needs. The department prepares graduates to take leadership roles in infrastructure development and environmental management, equipping them with advanced knowledge, critical thinking abilities, and the professional skills required to meet the challenges of a rapidly developing society.

The department currently has 43 faculty members, including 17 with doctoral degrees, all of whom are actively engaged in teaching, research, and professional activities. - **PO (a):** Apply knowledge of mathematics, natural science, engineering fundamentals and an engineering specialization as specified in K1 to K4 respectively to the solution of complex engineering problems.
- **PO (b):** Identify, formulate, research literature and analyse complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences and engineering sciences. (K1 to K4)
- **PO (c):** Design solutions for complex engineering problems and design systems, components or processes that meet specified needs with appropriate consideration for public health and safety, cultural, societal, and environmental considerations. (K5)

The Department of Civil Engineering at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET) is committed to excellence in undergraduate and postgraduate education, as well as research across a broad range of civil engineering disciplines. #### **Strength of Materials Laboratory**

The Strength of Materials Laboratory of the Department of Civil Engineering at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET) supports both teaching and research in structural engineering, solid mechanics, and construction materials. The laboratory is designed to equip students with practical knowledge and hands-on experience essential for the analysis and design of safe, efficient, and durable structures.

To meet the evolving demands of modern engineering practice, the laboratory facilitates learning in structural behavior, material properties, and advanced testing methodologies. It is integrated with the Engineering Materials Laboratory, and together they occupy approximately 5,000 square feet of floor space.

**Testing Facilities**

The laboratory is equipped to conduct a wide range of experiments, including:

The Geotechnical Engineering Laboratory of the Department of Civil Engineering at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET) supports teaching and research in soil mechanics, foundation engineering, and engineering geology. The laboratory plays a vital role in developing an understanding of the behavior of soils and rocks, and their application in the design and construction of civil engineering infrastructure, resource development, and hazard mitigation.

The laboratory is closely aligned with core courses such as soil mechanics, subsurface exploration and testing, foundation engineering, earth structures, and engineering geology.

Spanning approximately 2,100 square feet, the laboratory is equipped with modern facilities to support both undergraduate instruction and postgraduate research. It provides students with hands-on experience in determining the physical and mechanical properties of soils through a wide range of standard laboratory and field tests.

**Testing Facilities**

The laboratory is equipped to perform:

- Field identification tests of soils

#### **Environmental Engineering Laboratory**

The Environmental Engineering Laboratory of the Department of Civil Engineering at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET) supports teaching and research in water and wastewater engineering, environmental quality management, and pollution control. The laboratory plays a vital role in addressing contemporary environmental challenges, including water treatment, contaminant transport, and sustainable water resources management.

The laboratory is aligned with key areas such as physical, chemical, and biological treatment processes, environmental monitoring, and modeling of pollutant transport in natural and engineered systems.

Spanning approximately 2,200 square feet, the laboratory is equipped with modern instrumentation to support both undergraduate instruction and postgraduate research. It provides hands-on experience in the analysis and design of water supply and wastewater treatment systems.

**Testing Facilities**

The laboratory is equipped to perform a wide range of environmental analyses, including:

**Facilities for Teaching and Research**

The laboratory includes functional units and setups for water and wastewater treatment processes, enabling practical demonstration and research on treatment technologies and system performance.

#### **Transportation Engineering Laboratory**

The Transportation Engineering Laboratory of the Department of Civil Engineering at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET) supports teaching and research in transportation planning, traffic engineering, and pavement design. The laboratory provides essential knowledge and practical skills required for the planning, design, and implementation of transportation infrastructure systems.

The laboratory is aligned with coursework in transportation engineering, covering areas such as transportation planning and economics, traffic analysis, and the design of highways and other transportation facilities.

It enables students to gain hands-on experience in the design and evaluation of both bituminous and concrete pavements. The laboratory also facilitates testing of subgrade, sub-base, and base course materials, as well as bituminous mix design and roadway capacity analysis.

The Hydraulic Engineering Laboratory of the Department of Civil Engineering at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET) supports teaching and research in fluid mechanics, open channel flow, and hydraulic engineering. Spanning approximately 2,400 square feet, the laboratory is equipped to address multidisciplinary aspects of hydraulic engineering, including river engineering, sediment transport, and water resources systems.

## About

There is an endless demand in modern healthcare for technologies to improve the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of health problems. To meet this demand, the Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET) has a strong focus on health in its research and education programs and has a department devoted entirely to this socially vital area: Biomedical Engineering.

Biomedical engineering is the application of the principles and problem-solving techniques of engineering to biology and medicine. This is evident throughout healthcare, from diagnosis and analysis to treatment and recovery, and has entered the public conscience through the proliferation of implantable medical devices, such as pacemakers and artificial hips, to more futuristic technologies such as stem cell engineering and the 3-D printing of biological organs.

Biomedical engineers combine engineering approaches and principles with a rigorous knowledge of the biological and health sciences, working toward the embracive goal of improving human health. Career paths in biomedical engineering tend to be driven by the interests of the individual: the huge breadth of the field allows biomedical engineers to develop specialties in an area that interests them, be it biomaterials, neuromodulation devices, orthopedic repair, or even stem cell engineering. Biomedical engineers often combine an aptitude for problem-solving and technical know-how with focused study in medicine, healthcare, and helping others. It is this hybridization that has led to so much innovation—and so much opportunity—in biomedical engineering.

From the outset, the curriculum of our education programs integrates the natural sciences and engineering disciplines with biology and pathophysiology. It is designed to meld seamlessly with the research in our department.

## Vision

Our vision is to be the premier biomedical engineering platform in the world, based on the excellence of our people, our innovative multidisciplinary and enabling research, and our discovery-centered educational programs. We strive to pioneer the transfer of biomedical engineering research into applications that will advance and improve health care throughout Bangladesh and the world.

## Mission

The mission of the Department of Biomedical Engineering is to pursue excellence in biomedical engineering education, research, and innovation, creating and imparting knowledge for improving society, human health, and health care.

Biomedical engineering is a dynamic and exciting area that provides excellent career opportunities in various sectors of the society. - Wave and Antenna Training System (WATS-2002)
- Microwave Communication Trainer (MW-2000)
- Microwave Signal Generation, Modulation, Transmission, Reception Trainer (ED-3000)
- ADS Software
- 9 GHz Vector Network Analyzer

### Simulation Laboratory

In this laboratory, students can perform computer programming and numerical analysis lab, signals and systems lab, digital signal processing lab, multimedia communication lab, neural and fuzzy systems lab in C, C++, MATLAB, and Python to learn about different types of signal generation, manipulation of audio & video signals, spectral analysis, filter response, computer programming, etc. Besides, design and simulation of different logic circuits in the field of VLSI is done in this laboratory by Cadence Virtuoso Software. In internet programming, students learn about HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP and create databases for website development.

### Communication System Laboratory

Communication, the core of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering, is one that requires hands-on experience and practical demonstrations of systems in communication. Our Communication System Laboratory enables students to conduct their analog and digital communication lab, telecommunication networks, and switching lab with all the latest communication trainers. The lab provides the following trainers:

- Mobile Telecom Trainer
- Telecommunication Switching Trainer
- EPABX Trainer
- GSM Trainer
- GPS Trainer
- Analog Communication Trainer
- Digital Communication Trainer

### Computer Communications & Network Laboratory

To visualize the networking environments of communication systems, this well-resourced laboratory is equipped with LAN trainer, different types of networking devices, Cisco Packet Tracer, and Network Analyzer software, which are used to simulate and analyze network topologies, and configure Cisco routers and switches.

### Digital & Microprocessor Laboratory

In the Digital & Microprocessor Laboratory, students conduct experiments on digital logic circuits and also learn assembly language programming, generate hex code, and input it to the 8086 microprocessor kit. Our Digital & Microprocessor Laboratory provides the following setup:

- Digital Electronics Trainer Board
- Different types of Logic ICs
- MIDAS-8086 Microprocessor
- Microcontroller
- FPGA Trainer

### Optical Fiber Communication Laboratory

Optical Fiber Communication has revolutionized the telecommunications industry with its enormous advantages. Our Optical Fiber Communication Laboratory is enriched with the latest trainers like fiber optic analog and digital communication trainers, modulation and demodulation trainers, co-axial transmission line trainers, etc. to facilitate students' practical understanding.

### Biomedical Instrumentation Laboratory

The Biomedical Instrumentation Laboratory is for conducting experiments in the field of biomedical engineering. This laboratory includes a transducer trainer to observe several biomedical sensors' performance, ECG, EEG, EMG trainers to visualize their characteristics, and a Digital Electrocardiograph module to monitor real-time ECG.

Students in the first year have to undertake laboratory/sessional classes in Physics, Chemistry, and Electrical Circuit Laboratory. Initially, students will make use of all the laboratory facilities from the Department of EEE and the Department of CSE.

Albeit we are young in your journey, the quality, confidence, enthusiasm, and dedication we offer to lead Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering to new heights is indeed robust.

## Postgraduate Study Programs

The postgraduate program has a vigorous, rapidly expanding program of advanced study and research in the areas of Power system planning, Energy conversion, Optical fiber communication, Digital signal processing, Power semiconductor circuits, Industrial drives, MOS devices, Microwave theory and techniques, Laser theory, Artificial intelligence, and neural networks, etc. These postgraduate programs lead to the degree of Master of Science in Electrical and Electronic Engineering and Doctor of Philosophy in Electrical and Electronic Engineering.

To be awarded an M. Sc. degree, a student must complete 36 credit hours, of which a maximum of 09 credit hours are for project work or 18 credit hours are for thesis work. The degree requirement for a Ph.D. is 60 credit hours, of which a maximum of 45 credit hours are for the thesis.

### Research Facilities

The Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering has many advanced instruments and equipment with laboratories for studying various Electrical and Electronic Engineering problems.

#### Research Laboratory: Advanced Power System Laboratory

Objectives:

1. How to design and perform highly detailed simulation of power systems, and emulate the behavior of power system devices in different time scales.
1. How to conduct research and educational activities in the areas of Smart Grids with the changing environment resulting from the dramatic increase in deployments of renewable and distributed energy.
1. How to carry on distributed control and information exchange in the power system elements using compatible communication protocols (e.g., IEC61850).

#### Renewable Energy Lab: Solar Energy - Thin Film Solar Cells

Solar cells are a renewable way of producing electricity from sunlight without wearing out or consuming anything. Thin-film solar cells are the new generation of solar cells containing multiple thin-film layers of photovoltaic materials. The thin-film layers are deposited on a glass or plastic substrate, offering promising options for reducing photovoltaic system costs and increasing solar electricity market penetration.

The Department of Computer Science & Engineering offers two degree programs at the masters level- M.Sc. Engg. and M. Engg. For being qualified to be awarded M.Sc. Engg. degree a student must earn a minimum of 36 credit hours including a thesis of 18 credit hours whereas for M. Engg. degree a student must earn a minimum of 36 credit hours including a thesis of 6 credit hours. The graduate degrees offered in this department provide advanced course works and emphasize student research as well as numerous opportunities for interdisciplinary study.
